solution.p: Here are two different explanations of how two negative numbers can be added together.
Use a number line. Lets find -10+(-1).
First, find -10 on the number line. Next, since we are adding a negative number, we move left, in the negative direction, by 1 units. We will reach {-11} on the number line, which is the answer.
A second method asks you to think in terms of money. Lets find -10+(-1).
The first number is -10. Since its negative, its like you lost 10 dollars while gambling at the casino this morning.
The second number is -1. Since its negative, its like you lost 1 dollars again while gambling in the casino this afternoon.
Since you lost twice, you ended up losing a lot, implying the answer is negative.
Since you lost 10 dollars and then lost 1 dollars, it makes sense that you lost a total of {11} dollars. So the final answer is: -10+(-1)={-11}.
